definitions.gloss: selfish; self-centered; doing as one pleases
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior or a person who acts according to their own wishes without considering others. Strongly negative in nuance.

examples.japanese: {自分勝手|じぶんかって}なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な。
⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{自分勝手|じぶんかって}に⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{自分勝手|じぶんかって}な⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧がいなくなる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you keep behaving selfishly, you'll lose all your friends.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧ (oneself) and ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (one's own way). Describes someone who prioritizes their own desires without regard for how it affects others. It carries a clearly negative judgment.

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective modifying nouns ({自分勝手|じぶんかって}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧) or adverbially with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({自分勝手|じぶんかって}に⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Also functions as a noun: {自分勝手|じぶんかって}はやめろ (stop being selfish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧ — selfish behavior
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ — a selfish person
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ — to decide on one's own without consulting others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧ — selfish, spoiled; often used for children or in intimate relationships
- ⟦{身勝手|みがって}→身勝手：14345_migatte⟧ — selfish; very close synonym, slightly more literary
- ⟦{利己的|りこてき}→利己的：21285_rikoteki⟧ — egoistic; more formal and academic in tone
